svg.title: Iron Grind Fitness Gym — Complete Level 1 DFD
svg.desc: Nine process panels in Gane–Sarson notation, with external entities, separately identified data stores, and labeled data flows.

g.text: Iron Grind Fitness Gym — Complete Level 1 DFD
Gane–Sarson notation · nine processes · named actors and individual data stores
Each panel expands one Level 1 process. Repeated D identifiers refer to the same store. D12 is reserved and has no active process dependency in the documented model.
Membership review, user management, attendance, inventory, sales, reporting, and activity history use the individual flows shown below.

svg.text: Source: Chapter 3 Level 1 process/actor-flow model and User Login security-store supplement. SVG preview only; Word chapter has not been changed.
